extraction.title: Add caching support for IdentityProviderStorageProvider.getForLogin operations
extraction.head: feature-idp-cache-implementation

greptile.text: Summarizes the PR as adding caching for getForLogin in InfinispanIdentityProviderStorageProvider, keyed by realm ID, fetch mode, and organization ID, with invalidation only for login-affecting changes. Also describes a new BROKER_PUBLIC filter for organization-associated IdPs, defensive idp.isEnabled() re-checks in OrganizationAwareIdentityProviderBean, and a new test suite. Confidence score of 4/5.
Logic: the cleanup reference uses the wrong alias. It should be "idp-alias-" + i rather than "alias". Suggested change: use identityProviders().get("idp-alias-" + i)::remove in the addCleanup call.
Logic: same cleanup problem with the incorrect alias reference. Suggested change: use identityProviders().get("idp-alias-20")::remove in the addCleanup call.
Logic: calling session.identityProviders().getById(id) invokes the same provider recursively, which could cause inconsistent caching behavior. Suggested change: call idpDelegate.getById(id) instead.
